name: writer-pipeline
description: Multi-pipe starter for @jahbini/pipeline. Shared model in build/, multiple application pipes under pipes/. Each pipe is a working directory only; the MLX venv lives at the project base (./.venv, resolved via the runner's BASE lookup) and the UI is shared at the top.

scripts.clean: rm -rf .venv build/* pipes/*/state pipes/*/env pipes/*/logs pipes/*/runtime.sqlite* pipes/*/experiment.yaml pipes/*/params pipes/*/tested pipes/*/out pipes/*/data pipes/*/pipeline.json pipes/*/override pipes/*/control_override.yaml pipes/*/.venv && touch build/.gitkeep
